## Description
Summary of the changes made and the problem solved.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification
- [ ] Backend pytest unit tests pass (`cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/`)
- [ ] Ruff linting passes (`cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check app/ tests/`)
- [ ] Frontend type checking and build pass (`cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build`)
